# Singapore Property & Finance - Daily Brief (property + finance)
_Auto-generated 31 Jul 2026 (SGT). Source-linked. General information only; exact figures and eligibility are confirmed case by case._

## Policy & Regulatory Updates

- **15-month wait-out period for private property owners buying HDB resale flats removed** - The Government has removed the 15-month wait-out period with immediate effect, allowing eligible private residential property owners to buy resale HDB flats without waiting, following signs that the HDB resale market has stabilised. [Source](https://www.99.co/singapore/insider/15-month-period-removed-for-private-property-owners-buying-hdb-resale/)

- **Revised ABSD rules give developers more time to complete large en bloc redevelopment projects** - From 29 July, developers have up to seven years to complete and sell large en bloc redevelopment projects, with new sales deadlines and unit ratio requirements also introduced. [Source](https://stackedhomes.com/developers-face-easier-time-selling-large-enbloc-projects-but-not-sure-win-for-en-bloc-hopefuls/)

- **Property agents to face tougher renewal requirements from January 2027** - From 1 January 2027, Singapore property agents must complete at least three transactions every three years or pass a refresher examination to renew their registration, with DIY home listings also under regulatory review. [Source](https://stackedhomes.com/property-agents-in-singapore-face-tougher-rules-as-cea-raises-industry-standards-with-diy-home-listings-also-under-study/)

## Price & Market Movements

- **Private home prices rose 0.5% in Q2 2026, led by landed homes** - The URA's latest real estate statistics show the overall private residential property price index rose 0.5% QoQ in Q2 2026, easing from the 0.9% increase recorded in Q1, with landed homes driving the gains. [Source](https://www.99.co/singapore/insider/singapore-private-home-prices-q2-2026-report-breakdown/)

- **HDB resale prices fell 0.3% in Q2 2026 in second consecutive quarterly decline** - HDB's latest quarterly statistics show the Resale Price Index slipped 0.3% QoQ in Q2 2026, even as transaction activity edged higher. [Source](https://www.99.co/singapore/insider/hdb-resale-prices-fell-in-q2-2026-as-market-continues-to-stabilise/)

## New Launch & Resale Activity

- **Dunearn House sells 56% of units at launch weekend** - The 380-unit Dunearn House sold 212 units at an average price of S$3,140 psf during its launch weekend, marking the first private residential development within the upcoming Bukit Timah Turf City precinct. [Source](https://www.99.co/singapore/insider/dunearn-house-sells-212-units-averaging-3140-psf-at-launch/)

- **Condo resale volumes rebounded in June 2026 as buyers returned to the secondary market** - Singapore's private resale condo market saw prices hold largely flat in June 2026 while transaction volumes picked up, reflecting a period of stabilisation rather than strong acceleration or slowdown. [Source](https://www.99.co/singapore/insider/condo-resale-volumes-rebounded-in-june-2026-as-buyers-returned-to-the-secondary-market/)
